question: What capacity did the microporous carbon-sulfur cathode of the sodium-sulfur battery deliver at cycle 1500 at 1C?
rendered: According to the excerpt from "A Sugar-Derived Room-Temperature Sodium Sulfur Battery with Long Term Cycling Stability, page 5", the cathode tested at higher rates revealed similar behavior but after initial decay exhibited extremely stable capacity with 306 mAh/gS delivered at cycle 1500.
